subject.title: [Bug]: Memory dreaming narrative/REM lane is given apply_patch and misuses it

question: Should OpenClaw add a typed plugin subagent tool-restriction contract and apply it to memory-core Dream Diary narrative runs?
rationale: The repair changes a security-sensitive plugin/runtime boundary and public-ish plugin runtime API shape, so automation should not choose the permanent contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add typed subagent tool restrictions
options.body: Introduce a no-tools or allowlist field for plugin subagent runs, forward it through gateway agent dispatch, and set memory-core narrative runs to no tools.

options.title: Wait for broader toolsAllow work
options.body: Keep this issue open until related subagent `toolsAllow` plumbing is merged, then add the missing plugin-runtime forwarding and memory-core usage.

options.title: Use prompt-only mitigation
options.body: Tighten the narrative prompt but leave mutating tools available, which lowers log noise without fixing the tool-exposure boundary.

recommendation.title: Add typed subagent tool restrictions
recommendation.body: Introduce a no-tools or allowlist field for plugin subagent runs, forward it through gateway agent dispatch, and set memory-core narrative runs to no tools.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner has recent history across both memory-core narrative code and nearby plugin/gateway runtime surfaces.
